about: Style family per artist. Claude's read from artist knowledge, not measured and not stated by Krish. Correct freely. The first four families and their artists were set by the earlier session (99 tracks). On 2026-11-13 the other 247 tracks of the playlist were added: one agent proposed the four newer families from the unmapped artists, four agents assigned the artists, four more cross-checked each assignment; the three disagreements were settled by Claude. The match is on the credited artist name, case-insensitive.

german_melodic_deep.name: German and Euro melodic deep house
german_melodic_deep.description: Warm, patient, melodic 4/4 at 118-124 BPM: long builds, emotive leads, deep subs. Berlin and the Stil vor Talent / Suol orbit.

sunny_vocal_deep.name: Sunny deep house with a song in it
sunny_vocal_deep.description: The 2013-15 crossover sound: a folk or pop vocal, sax, marimba or plucked hook over a soft deep-house groove. Bright, major, warm.

uk_soulful_club.name: UK and soulful vocal house
uk_soulful_club.description: Garage swing, diva or soul vocals, organs and chunky basslines; disco and nu-disco edges.
artists: Mixed By Dario G & Mark Tucker

global_downtempo.name: Downtempo, trip-hop and global fusion
global_downtempo.description: Under or around 100 BPM, or swung: breakbeats, live instruments, world and Latin elements, electro-swing, cinematic chill.

melodic_progressive.name: Melodic progressive (Anjunadeep / Lane 8)
melodic_progressive.description: Anjunadeep and This Never Happened melodic progressive at 120-124 BPM: arpeggiated synth lines, rolling basslines, wide cinematic pads and long breakdowns into emotive peaks; bittersweet, mostly minor.

organic_afro_house.name: Organic, Afro and sunrise house
organic_afro_house.description: The All Day I Dream and TH3RD BRAIN orbit at 115-122 BPM: hand drums and shakers, kalimba, oud, flute and chanted or African vocals over soft, airy pads; dreamy, warm, often major.

future_bass_indie_electronic.name: Future bass and Aussie indie electronic
future_bass_indie_electronic.description: The 2014-17 Future Classic and Foreign Family sound: wonky or half-time beats around 75-110 BPM, side-chained supersaw chords, chopped and pitched vocal hooks and glossy indie-pop toplines; euphoric and nostalgic.

groove_tech_house.name: Groove-led tech house
groove_tech_house.description: The 2024-26 club turn at 124-130 BPM: rolling, swung basslines, crisp percussion, sparse stabs and chopped vocal hooks; driving and playful, with little harmony or melody.

no_family.about: Artists in the playlist that fit none of the families (old soul, hip-hop, rock, indie pop, spoken word). Claude's read.

low_confidence.about: Artists Claude knows little about; family judged from title, label and co-artists only.
